finding.note: hdlc_rx_greybus_frame passes peer-declared gb_frame->hdr.size (gb_msg_len) as the length to greybus_data_rcvd with no check against the actually received frame length len (<= MAX_RX_HDLC-4 = 255). Downstream 'size < msg_size' check is tautological (both come from hdr.size). Request direction memcpy in gb_operation_create_incoming copies gb_msg_len bytes from bg->rx_buffer (259 bytes) -> heap OOB read; response direction is cross-checked against local payload_size (asymmetric).

candidates.note: actual_length <= transfer_buffer_length = ES2_GBUF_MSG_SIZE_MAX = hd buffer_size_max; all downstream copies bounded.
peer bulk->actual only drives fragment copies bounded within the last pinned page (offset < PAGE_SIZE-64, len < 64).
bytes=min(count+1, dws<<2), fifo_write clamps to free space.
